summary: No-pivot + weak nonzero physical pair self-block + the current multiplicity-eight strong cross-Gram floor do not by themselves imply a bounded quadratic pushforward. The explicit rank-two matrix A=(1/20)[[0,J_243],[J_243,0]] has no 0.01 pivot, a pair H with ||A[H,H]||=0.05 and det(C C^T)=14641/40000>0.364944, but for iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2] inputs Q=(1/10)UV has a logarithmically unbounded density. This is not an s8 counterexample: rank(A)=2 and the pair Schur complement is exactly zero. Therefore the six Schur spectral directions forced by s8 after an invertible pair pivot (or equivalent global spectral provenance) are essential in the remaining threshold-eight receiver.
